question: Which chapter of the Aṃśumān-Kāśyapa concludes with the Gajahāri image characteristics?
premises: The text is identified as Aṃśumān-Kāśyapa.
The chapter concerns the characteristics of the Gajahāri image.
inference: This marks the seventy-third chapter on Gajahāri image characteristics in the Aṃśumān-Kāśyapa.
plain_english: Thus, in the Aṃśumān-Kāśyapa, this is the seventy-third chapter on the characteristics of the Gajahāri image.
